I searched one-way SFO to JFK for one passenger on SkyTrip. The cheapest flight is $259 and the most expensive is $1,189.

I checked two dates, Oct 13 and Oct 19 (the date the app filled in). Both returned the same 7 nonstop flights at the same prices. I didn't search Oct 14 or later, so I'm assuming the other days look the same.

| 7:30 AM – 12:42 PM | DL1358 | Main Cabin | $369.00 |
